repos_data.description: One endpoint in front of unlimited MCP servers and REST APIs. The agent sees a fixed ~15-tool surface however many you connect, so tool-list token cost stays flat (about 89% less on a 100-tool stack) and the savings climb as you add more. Single Rust binary.
One place to manage & connect to all your MCP servers
Local MCP broker that exposes one compact MCP entry for MCP clients while routing to many configured upstream servers.
Local-first MCP gateway. One port for every tool and every AI client: lazy discovery (~90% token savings), tool integrity + quarantine, secrets in the OS keychain.
The canonical open-source monorepo for production-ready MCP servers.
MCP Gateway - A meta-server for minimal Claude Code tool bloat with progressive disclosure
MCP server that exposes YepCode processes as callable tools for AI platforms. Securely connect AI assistants to your YepCode workflows, APIs, and automations.
MCP servers that help Claude Code/Cursor search your repo, docs, database, and git history instead of guessing.
MCP server for searching AI agents, MCP servers, CLI tools and agent skills via A2ASearch

Self-hosted, open-source AI-empowered MCP gateway: turn any API, database or MCP server into custom connectors for Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot & Cursor — no code. Convert REST, SOAP, WSDL, GraphQL & SQL to MCP, with OAuth2, RBAC & audit log. 175+ pre-built adapters (Deutsche Bahn, weclapp, Etsy, DHL, Shopware…)
An MCP server for finding MCP servers. Drop-in for Claude Desktop, Cursor, Cline, Zed.
Documentation Authority for AI Agents based upon Devdocs

repo_meta_data.description: A zero-dependency MCP and Local tool gateway: host your own tools in any language, forward and curate tools from other MCP servers, expose them leanly to cut agent token cost, gate every call through your own policy hooks before it runs, create your own MCP servers easily with zero code - and wrap any MCP server so it speaks both protocol eras! :)
